technology_name: Production of Sugarcane Wine with Different Fruit Blends
institution: ICAR-Sugarcane Breeding Institute Research Centre, Kannur
problem_solved: Limited flavour diversity and acceptability of sugarcane wine
description: This technology combines sugarcane juice with different fruit pulps to produce blended wines with improved flavour, colour, and consumer acceptability. The process utilizes locally available fruits and integrates them with sugarcane juice to create diversified fermented beverage products.
applications:
Fruit wine and fermented beverage manufacturers
Sugarcane processing and value-addition enterprises
Food and beverage startups developing specialty drinks
Agro-processing units utilizing local fruit resources
Hospitality, tourism, and artisanal beverage industries
secondary_sector: Consumer & Lifestyle Products, Agribusiness & Rural Economy
